question: Who among the following became the first Indian musician to be honoured with the Ramon Magsaysay award, which is considered to be Asia's Nobel Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Subbulakshmi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Carnatic singe**r MS Subbulakshmi was from** Madurai, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• She was the very first artist to ever get the **Bharat Ratna.**
 
• In **1974, **she became the first artist from India to earn the** Ramon Magsaysay award.**
 
• In **1966**, she was the first Indian to perform before the **UN General Assembly. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandarva** :​

 
 
• Pandit Kumar Gandharva, originally known as Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath was an Indian classical singer.
 
• Known for his unique vocal style and for his refusal to be bound by the tradition of any gharana.
 
 
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar:**
 
 
• Lata Mangeshkar was an** Indian playback singe**r and **occasional music composer**.
 
• The** "Queen of Melody," the "Nightingale of India," and the "Voice of the Millennium" **were all titles she held.
 
• She was among the first playback singers from India to appear in the **Royal Albert Hall in London, UK, in 1974.**
 
 
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar:**
 
 
• Pandit Ravi Shankar was an **Indian sitarist and composer.**
 
• In **1999, **Shankar received the **Bharat Ratna,** India's highest civilian honor.
